new_entities.name: Handles, hinges and push-buttons of doors, luggage compartments and bonnets
Wheels, wheel nuts, hub caps and wheel discs

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall not exceed 40 mm in the case of door or luggage compartment handles and 30 mm in all other cases
obligations.ears: The projection of handles, hinges and push-buttons shall not exceed 40 mm in the case of door or luggage compartment handles and 30 mm in all other cases.

derived.text: The projection of door or luggage compartment handles shall not exceed 40 mm.
The projection of hinges, push-buttons and other handles shall not exceed 30 mm in all other cases.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall meet one or other of the following requirements
obligations.ears: If lateral door handles rotate to operate, the lateral door handles shall meet one or other of the following requirements.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: the open end of handles must be directed towards the rear
obligations.ears: When handles rotate parallel to the plane of the door, the open end of the handles shall be directed towards the rear.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be turned back towards the plane of the door and fitted into a protective surround or be recessed
obligations.ears: When handles rotate parallel to the plane of the door, the end of such handles shall be turned back towards the plane of the door and fitted into a protective surround or be recessed.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: be enclosed in a protective surround or be recessed
obligations.ears: When handles which pivot outwards in any direction which is not parallel to the plane of the door are in the closed position, the handles shall be enclosed in a protective surround or be recessed.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall face either rearwards or downwards
obligations.exception: Nevertheless, handles which do not comply with this last condition may be accepted if:
obligations.ears: For handles which pivot outwards not parallel to the plane of the door, the open end shall face either rearwards or downwards.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: may be accepted
obligations.ears: Handles which do not comply with this last condition may be accepted if the following conditions are met.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply.
obligations.ears: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to wheels, wheel nuts, hub caps and wheel discs.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: shall not exhibit any pointed or sharp projections that extend beyond the external plane of the wheel rim
obligations.ears: The wheels, wheel nuts, hub caps and wheel discs shall not exhibit any pointed or sharp projections that extend beyond the external plane of the wheel rim.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall not be allowed
obligations.ears: Wing nuts shall not be allowed.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: no part of the wheels other than the tyres, situated above the horizontal plane passing through their axis of rotation shall project beyond the vertical projection, in a horizontal plane of the external surface or structure
obligations.exception: However, if functional requirements so warrant, wheel discs which cover wheel and hub nuts may project beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure
obligations.ears: When the vehicle is travelling in a straight line, no part of the wheels other than the tyres, situated above the horizontal plane passing through their axis of rotation shall project beyond the vertical projection, in a horizontal plane of the external surface or structure.

obligations.subject: n11
obligations.response: may project beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure on condition that the radius of curvature of the surface of the projecting part is not less than 30 mm and that the projection beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure in no case exceeds 30 mm
obligations.ears: If functional requirements so warrant, wheel discs which cover wheel and hub nuts may project beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure on condition that the radius of curvature of the surface of the projecting part is not less than 30 mm and that the projection in no case exceeds 30 mm.

derived.text: If functional requirements so warrant, the radius of curvature of the surface of the projecting part of wheel discs which cover wheel and hub nuts shall be not less than 30 mm.
If functional requirements so warrant, the projection of wheel discs beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure shall in no case exceed 30 mm.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: shall not be permitted
obligations.exception: unless they are folded back or are fitted with a shield meeting the requirements of this Regulation which are applicable to it
obligations.ears: Sheet-metal edges, such as gutter edges and the rails of sliding doors, shall not be permitted unless they are folded back or are fitted with a shield meeting the requirements of this Regulation which are applicable to it.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: shall be considered to be folded back either if it is folded back by approximately 180º, or if it is folded towards the bodywork in such a manner that it cannot be contacted by a sphere having a diameter of 100 mm
obligations.ears: An unprotected edge shall be considered to be folded back either if it is folded back by approximately 180º, or if it is folded towards the bodywork in such a manner that it cannot be contacted by a sphere having a diameter of 100 mm.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply
obligations.ears: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to the following sheet metal edges: rear edge of bonnet and front edge of rear luggage boot.

obligations.subject: n6
obligations.response: may have a radius of curvature of less than 2.5 mm provided that it is not less than one-tenth of the height "H" of the projection
obligations.ears: Folds in body panels may have a radius of curvature of less than 2.5 mm provided that it is not less than one-tenth of the height "H" of the projection, measured in accordance with the method described in paragraph 1. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n7
obligations.response: shall have a radius of curvature of at least 1 mm on edges capable of being directed outwards
obligations.ears: Lateral deflectors shall have a radius of curvature of at least 1 mm on edges capable of being directed outwards.

obligations.subject: n8
obligations.response: shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying vertically above them
obligations.exception: As an exception to this requirement an exhaust pipe may project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line, so long as it terminates in rounded edges, the minimum radius of curvature being 2.5 mm.
obligations.ears: The jacking brackets and exhaust pipe(s) shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying vertically above them.

derived.text: The jacking brackets shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying vertically above them.
The exhaust pipe(s) shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying vertically above them.

obligations.subject: n9
obligations.response: may project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line, so long as it terminates in rounded edges, the minimum radius of curvature being 2.5 mm
obligations.ears: An exhaust pipe may project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line, so long as it terminates in rounded edges, the minimum radius of curvature being 2.5 mm.

values.raw: minimum radius of curvature being 2.5 mm

obligations.subject: n10
obligations.response: shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. above in all positions of use
obligations.ears: Air intake and outlet flaps shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. above in all positions of use.
